In the Quran, Daniel is mentioned as one of the prophets who received divine revelations and was known for his ability to interpret dreams. The story of Daniel in the Islamic tradition emphasizes his strong faith, unwavering commitment to God, and his willingness to defy oppressive rulers for the sake of truth and justice. Daniel's courage and wisdom continue to inspire Muslims to stand up for their beliefs and to seek knowledge and understanding.

Ultimately, the name Daniel calls us to live our lives in a way that reflects the wisdom and courage of the prophet Daniel, seeking guidance from God and striving to create positive change in the world.
